## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

*Sanidassanattika, Lokiyaduka* is an Abhidhamma text situated within the *Paṭṭhāna* of the Pali Tipiṭaka. Structurally, it analyzes conditional relationships by combining the *sanidassana-ttika* (the triad of visible states) with the *lokiya-duka* (the dyad of mundane and supramundane phenomena) according to the conditional system characteristic of the *Paṭṭhāna*.
